title: The Existence of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The existence of God means that the living Creator truly is, and all creation depends on Him. God is not an idea invented by man, but the eternal Lord who reveals Himself through what He has made and through His Word.
summary: The existence of God means that the living Creator truly is, and all creation depends on Him. God is not an idea invented by man, but the eternal Lord who reveals Himself through what He has made and through His Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reveals the living God fully and personally. In Him, the God who made all things draws near, speaks, saves, and calls sinners to know the Father through the Son.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture begins with God. It does not argue as though God must be placed under human judgment before He may be believed. It declares that in the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

Creation itself bears witness that God exists. His invisible attributes, eternal power, and divine nature are displayed through what He has made. People may suppress that truth, but they are not left without witness.

The existence of God also means that human beings are accountable to Him. Life, breath, place, purpose, and worship are not self-created. Every person lives before the God who made them and calls them to seek Him.

Faith begins with the truth that God is and that He rewards those who diligently seek Him. The Christian faith is not built on wishful thinking, but on the living God who speaks, acts, creates, judges, saves, and reigns.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
When people deny God, they do not become free; they lose the foundation for truth, worship, morality, dignity, and hope. A world without God becomes a world where human opinion tries to carry the weight only God can bear.

This doctrine gives believers confidence that their faith rests on reality. The God who exists is not distant from His creation. He has made Himself known, and He invites people to seek Him, trust Him, and find life in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live before God as the One who truly is. Do not treat Him as a theory, feeling, tradition, or emergency helper. Worship Him as Creator, seek Him through His Word, and speak of Him with humble confidence to those who have forgotten that their life and breath come from Him.
